Passwords are taken as plain text and securely hashed before storage.

This DTO is used for member self-registration. Client must provide necessary fields only.

password.description: Plain text password provided by the member for registration

email.description: Email address of the member for communication and authentication

created_at.description: Timestamp when the member account was created. Optional and populated by the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the member account information was last updated. Optional and populated by the system.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the member account was deleted (soft delete). Null if active. Optional and populated by the system.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the member account was deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardGuestSession.IReq.description: Search and pagination parameters for retrieving guest session records in the EconPolDiscussionBoard system.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardGuestSession.description:
Guest session records for the EconPol Discussion Board system.

These records capture metadata of individual guest browsing sessions such as IP address, accessed URL, referrer URL, and timestamps. Each session belongs to a guest user identified by econ_pol_discussion_board_guest_id.

This schema represents both stored session data and response format for session retrieval operations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the guest session.

econ_pol_discussion_board_guest_id.description: Foreign key referencing the guest owning this session.

ip.description: IP address of the guest during the session.

href.description: URL accessed by the guest during the session.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the source or previous page.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the guest session expired, if applicable.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardGuestSession.ICre.description:
Data required to create a new guest session record.

Includes IP address, accessed URL, referrer URL, and optionally expiry timestamp.

The foreign key to the guest user is provided via the API path parameter.

This DTO is used in POST requests to create sessions for unauthenticated guests.

ip.description: IP address of the guest during the session.

href.description: URL accessed by the guest during the session.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the source or previous page.

expired_at.description: Optional expiry timestamp for the guest session.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardGuestSession.IUpd.description:
Data fields for updating a guest session record in the econPolDiscussionBoard system.

Allows modification of IP address, accessed URL, referrer URL, and expiration timestamp for a specific guest session.

oneOf.description: IP address of the guest user's session. Can be null if unknown.

ip.description: IP address of the guest user's session. Can be null if unknown.

oneOf.description: The URL that the guest user accessed during this session. Can be null if not recorded.

href.description: The URL that the guest user accessed during this session. Can be null if not recorded.

oneOf.description: The URL of the page that referred the guest user to the current page. Can be null if this is a direct visit.

referrer.description: The URL of the page that referred the guest user to the current page. Can be null if this is a direct visit.

oneOf.description: Timestamp indicating when the session expires. Null if the session does not expire.

expires_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the session expires. Null if the session does not expire.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardMember.description:
Members with authenticated accounts on econPolDiscussionBoard including username, email, and authentication info.

This entity stores member details, authentication credentials, and timestamps for account management.

Passwords are securely stored in hashed form and not exposed via APIs.

Used in member management and authentication processes.

username.description: Unique user name chosen by the member (global scope)

email.description: Email address of the member for communication and authentication

created_at.description: Timestamp when the member account was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the member account information was last updated

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the member account was deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardMember.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing econPolDiscussionBoard member account.

Allows modification of mutable fields such as password and email, excluding immutable fields like username.

The updated_at timestamp is managed automatically by the system upon successful update.

Per security policy, clients must send plain 'password' field instead of hashed password.

password.description: Plain text password for member authentication. Backend will handle hashing securely.

email.description: Unique email address of the member.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardMemberSession.IRe.description:
Query parameters for filtering and paginating econPolDiscussionBoard member sessions.

Supports pagination, sorting, and filtering by date and status.

This DTO is used to search sessions related to a specific member identified by username in API endpoints.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page.

sort_by.description: Field to sort the results by, e.g., 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order, ascending or descending.
Sort order, ascending or descending.

search.description: Keyword for searching session related fields.

status.description: Status filter to include sessions with specific states, e.g., 'active', 'inactive'.

created_from.description: Filter sessions created at or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

created_to.description: Filter sessions created before this ISO 8601 datetime.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardMemberSession.description: Detailed information about a member's login session in the econPolDiscussionBoard system, tracking connection metadata and session lifecycle.

id.description: Unique identifier of the member session record.

member_username.description: Unique username of the discussion board member owning this session.

ip.description: IP address of the client initiating the session. Nullable if not known.

href.description: URL of the page where the session started, typically the current page URL.

referrer.description: URL of the previous page visited before this session started.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session is expired or invalid. Nullable if the session is active.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardMemberSession.ICr.description:
Information required to create a new login session for a discussion board member.

This schema contains the necessary session context fields that the client must provide when creating a new session.

Session context fields `href` and `referrer` are mandatory, while `ip` is optional and nullable to allow server extraction or client provision for SSR (Server-Side Rendering) scenarios.

ip.description: IP address of the client creating the session. Optional as server can extract, but client may provide for SSR.

href.description: URL of the page from where login is initiated. Mandatory for session context.

referrer.description: URL of the previous page trusted as referrer. Mandatory for session context.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardMemberSession.IUp.description:
Data structure for updating an authenticated member's session information in the econPolDiscussionBoard system.

This schema represents the fields that can be modified for a member's active session, such as IP address, accessed URL, referrer, and expiration timestamp. It excludes immutable fields like the primary ID, creation timestamp, and member identifier to maintain data integrity and security.

The update typically occurs when refreshing session state for tracking user activity and security monitoring.

ip.description: IP address of the member during the session. Optionally nullable for flexibility.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expired, if applicable.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAdmin.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering and retrieving econPolDiscussionBoard administrator accounts.

This schema allows specifying pagination settings and search filters, such as username and email, to efficiently manage and retrieve subsets of administrator accounts from the system.

The request ensures that only authorized users perform searches and that queries are constrained within system policies for security and performance.

page.description: Page number for pagination requested by the client.

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per page.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort the results by.

oneOf.description: Sort order, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

order.description: Sort order, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

email.description: Administrator email address for communication and recovery, used for notifications and recovery procedures.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft deleted. Null if the account is active.

role.description: Role of the administrator within the system. Expected values include 'admin', 'superadmin', and other elevated roles granting specific privileges.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the administrator account is currently active or disabled. True for active accounts, false for disabled or suspended accounts.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAdmin.description:
Detailed administrator account information of the econPolDiscussionBoard system.

Represents privileged users responsible for system management and content moderation.

Includes username, email, hashed password, and timestamps for account lifecycle management.

Sensitive password data is never exposed in client API responses except where authorized.

This schema corresponds to the `econ_pol_discussion_board_admins` table in the Prisma schema.

adminUsername.description: Unique administrator username to identify the new admin

email.description: Administrator email address for notifications and recovery

password.description: Plain text password to be securely hashed by the server for authentication

role.description: Role assigned to the new administrator, typically 'admin'

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAdmin.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a new administrator account in the econPolDiscussionBoard system.

Includes username, email, plain text password (which will be hashed server-side), and role.

Used for admin account onboarding by authorized administrator actors.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAdmin.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for securely updating an existing administrator account in the econPolDiscussionBoard system. Allows updating email address and plaintext password for backend hashing. Username is immutable and system fields are managed server-side and not allowed in request.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAdminSession.description:
Administrator session entity for the econPolDiscussionBoard system.

Represents a login session of an administrator account, tracking connection details such as IP address, accessed URLs, and timestamps. Each session is uniquely linked to an admin user via their username identifier.

Used to support authentication auditing, session management, and security compliance within the administrative backend.

id.description: Unique identifier of the admin session record.

econPolDiscussionBoardAdminId.description: UUID of the administrator who owns this session, linked to econ_pol_discussion_board_admins table's id.

ip.description: IP address of the administrator during this session.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating previous page before accessing this session.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

expiredAt.description: Optional timestamp indicating when the session expired, if applicable.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAdminSession.ICre.description:
Request body schema for creating a new administrator session in econPolDiscussionBoard system.

Includes connection metadata such as client's IP address, accessed URL, referrer URL, and optional expiration timestamp.

Field values must be provided by the client to establish accurate session records.

Admin identifier is extracted from the authenticated admin context and must NOT be supplied by the client.

This schema excludes internal system fields like id and creation timestamps because these are generated server-side.

href.description: Accessed URL during the session initiation.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating previous page or source of the session initiation.

expiredAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the session.

ip.description: IP address of the admin during the session.

expiredAt.description: Timestamp when the session expired, if applicable.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAdminSession.IUpd.description: Data required to update an administrator session record including connection details and optional expiration timestamp.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardArticle.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new article on the economic and political discussion board.

Includes title, content, and optionally attachments.
Author ID is excluded because it is derived from the authenticated member's identity and must not be supplied by the client.

Input validation enforces content length restrictions and sanitizes content to prevent XSS attacks.

content.description: Content text of the new article

attachments.description: List of attachments associated with the article

username.description: Unique username of the member used for login and identification.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAttachment.ICreat.description:
Schema for creating a new attachment associated with an article in the EconPolDiscussionBoard system.

Includes critical file metadata such as attachment type, file URL, and file name. The create DTO excludes ID and timestamps which are system-generated.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardArticle.description:
Detailed information about a specific article in the economic and political discussion board system.

Includes the article's unique identifier, title, full content text, the author member's summary information, and timestamps for creation and last update.

This schema is used for retrieving full article details by authenticated members who have permission to view the article.

author.description: Summary information of the member who authored the article

created_at.description: Timestamp when the article was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the article was last updated

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAttachment.description:
Attachment entity representing uploaded files linked to econPolDiscussionBoard articles.

Includes metadata for file management, classification, and audit tracking.

Used in response bodies to confirm upload details and list attachments.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardAttachment.ISumma.description:
Summary of attachment data for articles on the economic and political discussion board.

This summary type includes the essential metadata of attachments such as their unique identifier, the type of attachment (image or file), the accessible URL, original file name, and the timestamp of upload. It is used to provide a concise overview of each attachment linked to an article, enabling efficient display in lists or references without loading full attachment details.

Security considerations ensure that only authorized members can access these summaries. Sensitive or internal metadata are excluded for privacy and integrity.

url.description: URL location where the attachment file is stored.

uploaded_at.description: Timestamp when the attachment was uploaded.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardComment.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new comment in the EconPolDiscussionBoard.

Members must provide the comment body and may optionally specify a parent comment for nested replies.
The article and member IDs are provided as path parameters and thus are excluded here.

The operation enforces a maximum length of 500 characters for the comment body.

parentCommentId.description: Optional parent comment ID for threading. Null if this is a top-level comment.

body.description: Textual content of the comment, with a maximum length of 500 characters.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardComment.description:
Detailed information of a single comment in the EconPolDiscussionBoard system.

Represents a comment posted by an authenticated member on an article, allowing nested replies through optional parent comment references.
Includes metadata fields to track creation and modification timestamps.

This schema is the primary server-side representation used in API responses for comment retrieval.

Foreign keys to article and member entities are transformed to reference objects to provide complete context in one API call.

Nested child comments are included in the children composition array for atomic read completeness.

Parent comment ID is kept as raw ID to prevent circular reference since parent contains children array.

article.description: Summary object of the article to which this comment belongs.

author.description: Summary of the member who authored this comment.

parent_id.description: Optional reference to the parent comment for nested replies, null if this comment is a top-level comment.

body.description: The textual content of the comment, limited to 500 characters.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the comment was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the comment.

IEconPolDiscussionBoardComment.IUpdate.description: Fields for updating an existing comment on the econPolDiscussionBoard. Allows modification of the comment text and optionally its nesting through the parent comment reference.

body.description: New text content of the comment, limited to 500 characters
